Karibu, welcome to the Usambara Mountains

My name is Mahanyu, and I am proud to call these mountains home. Growing up in Lushoto, I came to know its trails, its stories and the Shambaa traditions that make this place so special. I love sharing them with every guest who walks with me.

Whether you would like a gentle village walk, a rainforest trek or a multi-day hike, I will shape the day around your pace and interests. Every tour is safe, relaxed and personal, with fair prices and no middleman fees. I also take photos and videos along the way, so you leave with memories to keep.
